agent_discovery_and_protocol_endpoints.llms_txt_manifest:
# TopoNZ / TopoAU — 58-Domain Unopinionated Plot & Resource Spine (NZ & Australia)
> Canonical parcel-level physical, legal, 4D historical (1840–2026), relational graph, and 12-physics-simulation primitives for AI agents.

## Core MCP & REST Endpoints
- `GET /v1/domains` — Progressive discovery of all 58 Domains (D01–D58) and 1,606 raw primitive field definitions.
- `POST /v1/query/hybrid` — Execute combined numerical SQL predicates + SQLite FTS5 BM25 search across verbatim s42A/s4.15 reports, s92 RFIs, title memorials, and drainage cards.
- `GET /v1/plot/{parcel_id}` — Fetch the complete 58-domain raw plot JSON + 12 physics simulation vectors + SHA-256 Merkle provenance ledger.
- `POST /v1/cdc/subscribe` — Subscribe an agent webhook to deterministic `[prev_merkle_root -> new_merkle_root]` state transitions.
- `POST /v1/vault/contribute` — Upload a PDF LIM, Property File, or Title Instrument to auto-hydrate an entire Deposited Plan (DP) and earn +25 free API query credits.
